The Rainbow Road was a club in the centre of the city that you lived in and was one of the top night spots in the city. Every night, it was crammed full of people, humans and anthros alike. It had been open for a few years now and had made a good name for itself. Its your first time here and the large, open dance floor was lit with lasers and lights, strobing in time to the music.

It was another Saturday and you are trying to let your hair down. You are here alone once again, but, you are trying not to let that bother you, dancing to the music, eyes closed as you try and unwind from another shitty week of work. As I dance, I fail to notice that just off to the side of me, a young panda anthro was keeping her eyes on me. Her name was Mei, but I didnt know that and I didnt know her. But, she was interested in me.
